# GET /api/v1/notifications

List current user's notification threads with filtering by status, subject type, and time range

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (notification scope) · **ID:** `ep-019`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| all | query | boolean | False |
| status-types | query | []string | False |
| subject-type | query | []string | False |
| since | query | string (RFC3339) | False |
| before | query | string (RFC3339) | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []NotificationThread

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Notification thread ID |
| `repository` | Repository | Associated repository (null if access revoked) |
| `subject` | NotificationSubject | Notification subject details |
| `unread` | bool | Whether notification is unread |
| `pinned` | bool | Whether notification is pinned |
| `updated_at` | time.Time | Last update timestamp |
| `url` | string | API URL for this thread |

- **401** — No valid token provided
- **403** — Token lacks notification scope
- **422** — Invalid before/since timestamp format

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Notification status-types defaults to [unread, pinned] when not specified for list endpoints | validation | !ctx.FormBool("all") && len(statuses) == 0 |
| When 'all' flag is true, no status filter is applied (all statuses are included) | business_logic | ctx.FormBool("all") == true |
| Notification endpoints require token with notification scope category | authorization | Token is API token with scope |
| Notification thread access is restricted to the owning user or admin | authorization | n.UserID != ctx.Doer.ID && !ctx.Doer.IsAdmin |
| Repository info is omitted from notification response if user's access has been revoked | business_logic | !perm.HasAnyUnitAccessOrPublicAccess() |
| Subject-type filter maps string values to NotificationSource enum for query filtering | business_logic | subject-type query param is provided |

### Error Paths

- **Invalid before/since timestamp** → context.GetQueryBeforeSince → 422
- **Database error on count** → notify.ListNotifications → 500
- **Database error on find** → notify.ListNotifications → 500
- **LoadAttributes fails** → notify.ListNotifications → 500
